learning_objective: 🎯 To appreciate the beautiful bond of friendship and learn how to support, care, and pray for the well-being of our friends.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The poem is a sweet wish from one friend to another. It talks about wanting happiness, peace, and success for the person you care about most.
A true friend prays not just for good times, but promises to give comfort and a shoulder to cry on when there is sadness or sorrow.
Friends act like bright stars for each other. The prayer asks for the strength to always guide and support each other through life's long journey.
The ultimate message is that distance or time cannot break real friendship. The love and care in a friend's heart stay forever.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Make a Friendship Card!
fun_activity.instructions: Create a small, beautiful card for your best friend. Write one special wish or 'prayer' you have for them inside it!

quick_recap: ⭐ The poem expresses pure love and good wishes for a friend.
⭐ It promises support during both happy days and sad times.
⭐ It shows that true friends help guide each other like shining stars.
⭐ Real friendship is a precious bond that lasts a lifetime.
